title: Hittite remains in underground cities show they were reused

tellings.quote: they found uh evidence of Hittites and evidence of um ancient cultures that are not like Ancient Ancient

plain: Derinkuyu, in Turkey, is a city carved deep underground out of soft rock. A researcher called Matt, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that evidence of the Hittites, an ancient people of the region, and of other cultures that are "not Ancient Ancient" has been found there. As he tells it, this means later peoples moved into these tunnels and reused them, which would make the cities older than the people found living in them.
